_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4Jsmd91BqTVB7dSii9uJMV)_

Refs #32980

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:公式技能文档(skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md)的「想要/写法」表加一行:两个日期时间之间相差几小时,写 `double((datetime(b) - datetime(a)).getMinutes()) / 60.0`。
- 为什么单独一个 PR:skills/** 是受管路径,需要授权审批人合并;#32980 的代码和文案修复在 PR #33291 里正常落地,不必等这一行。
- 风险:只加一行文档,不改任何可编写的元数据。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, Dates table: one row, "Hours between date-times" → `double((datetime(record.end_at) - datetime(record.start_at)).getMinutes()) / 60.0`, between "Tenure in years" and "Sub-day offset". It is the form the date-subtraction refusals name after PR #33291 (#32980). Changeset: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

Split from PR #33291 at the seat's direction so the code fix is not held by the tier H approval this path needs.

## Tests

No code changes. The row is byte-identical to the one PR #33291 carried at `4350de67`, where `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-examples` and `check:doc-formula-expressions` ran exit 0 and the expression was pinned to validate clean and evaluate to 98 and 3.5 on two served rows (`packages/formula/src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`). Pre-push hooks passed on this branch at `68d9bf74`.

## Verification

Branch cut from `origin/main` (no merge needed).
